injuries.detail: Stewart is out for Monday's game against the Wizards due to an illness.
Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.
Jackson will undergo surgery to repair the broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot and is set to miss significant time.
Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Wizards.
Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.
The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
